build_dictionary: build a masked LM dictionary from text filenames with threshold and nwords options
load_dictionary: load a masked LM dictionary from a dict.txt file for cross-lingual LM tasks
setup_task: setup a cross-lingual LM task by loading the dictionary and initializing the task class
load_dataset: load a multi-lingual dataset split as a MaskedLMDataset wrapped in MultiCorpusSampledDataset
add_args: add cross-lingual LM task arguments like data path, tokens per sample, and monolingual langs
